title: Glessner's courtyard chimneys stand where the survey plans put them
items: The two chimneys on the courtyard side of Glessner House's 18th Street wing now stand over the flues the 1963 survey plans draw. The middle one is about 8 ft further west, over the courtyard door, and the other sits in the inner corner against the stable.
The middle chimney is also 2 ft taller, so it still clears the wing's raised ridge.
The great chimney beside the copper roof was checked against the survey and photographs, and is unchanged.
